90001.name: Earthquake
90001.description: You experience natural disaster and parts of your body are permanently damaged.

90003.name: Farewell, Mom
90003.description: Your mom dies from an incurable rare disease. You experience a mental breakdown.

90004.name: Bankruptcy
90004.description: After being scammed out of a large sum of money, you fall seriously ill.

90005.name: Rape
90005.description: You are raped by a distant relative from your father’s side.

90006.name: Helen of Troy
90006.description: Almost overnight, you become drop-dead gorgeous and become the center of attention ever since.

90007.name: Job oppotunity
90007.description: You gain an opportunity to realize your personal value.

90008.name: You are beautiful
90008.description: You undergo a minimally invasive cosmetic procedure.

90009.name: A miracle of life
90009.description: You become a participant in the latest full-body medical scan, and during the examination, every ailment you have—whether major or minor—is cured all at once.

90010.name: Queen's gambit
90010.description: Your mom makes you take the new "Grow Happy" drug. It significantly boosts your intelligence.

90011.name: Pac-Man Power
90011.description: Nano-swarm eats your arterial gunk while playing digital Pac-Man. Your mitochondria get so hyped they act 12 again—congratulations, you are blessed for being a good host.

90012.name: Iron Lung
90012.description: Lost a lung in a hoverboard oopsie; they print a new one with coral-reef stem-cell ink. Now it photosynthesizes and filters smog—you outlive everyone purely because you breathe profit.

90013.name: meta-Zen
90013.description: A mandatory empathy-drop plugs you into a day as a grumpy octopus off Chile. After that, your ex’s texts feel like static—you achieve meta-Zen and start cackling at funerals.

90014.name: Emo Implant
90014.description: You buy the Emotional Climate Control implant—it mutes your ex’s dopamine hits and filters global dread. You cry happy tears for three days straight and still don’t know why.

90015.name: Dumb Luck Tsunami
90015.description: You accidentally buy 50k stinky-rock NFTs; a senile trillionaire decides they're the next big thing. You wake up owning a floating trash-barge island—but hey, it's your trash barge.

90016.name: The Silence of the Lambs
90016.description: Your dentures’ Wi-Fi signature has a unique quantum wobble; a Telecom cartel pays you billions for the "spectrum rights" to your mouth. You get paid to keep shut—numbers now use scientific notation.

90017.name: Gul'dan, what must we give it return?
90017.description: The Quantum Brain Bridge vaccine makes you solve differential equations in your sleep—but permanently erases "potato" from your memory. You argue Kant with your toaster; +4 IQ, minus social grace.

90018.name: Cognition Curse
90018.description: You snort Cognition Dust at a retro-rave and compress the Library of Congress into your temporal lobe. You can recite Pi to 10k digits—and precisely calculate how much everyone annoys you. Genius, and you hate it.
